entries.name: Platt and isotonic calibrators
entries.purpose: Map raw probabilities to calibrated probabilities.

opus.name: Platt and isotonic calibrators
opus.purpose: Map raw probabilities to calibrated probabilities.
opus.method: Platt: in-house logistic on logit(p) (400 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.001), needs >=10 rows and both classes. Isotonic: pool-adjacent-violators on predictions sorted ascending, blocks store max prediction & mean label; predict = first block whose maxPrediction >= p (step function, no interpolation); above last block -> last block mean.

entries.name: Calibration requirement and cross-validated method selection
entries.purpose: Decide whether post-calibration is needed and pick raw/Platt/isotonic.

opus.name: Calibration requirement and cross-validated method selection
opus.purpose: Decide whether post-calibration is needed and pick raw/Platt/isotonic.
opus.method: Requires post-calibration if |mean pred - goal rate| >= 0.02 or any 10-equal-width-bin gap >= 0.10 (bins with >=5 rows). Folds = min(5, max(2, positives)), stratified round-robin by sorted rowId. Compare raw vs CV Platt vs CV isotonic by log loss then Brier. Calibrator fit on VALIDATION split only, then applied to all splits.

opus.name: Binary logistic regression trainer (in-house gradient descent)
opus.purpose: Fit the production shot-goal model (logistic_l2) and calibrators.
opus.method: Full-batch gradient descent from zero weights/bias: grad = sum(error*x*w)/totalWeight; update w -= lr*(grad + l1*sign(w) + l2*w); bias unpenalized. Defaults: 800 iterations, lr 0.05. Families: logistic_unregularized (l1=0,l2=0), logistic_l2 (l2=0.01), logistic_elastic_net (l1=0.001,l2=0.01). Output clipped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9]. No convergence check.

opus.purpose: Estimate one coefficient per skater for on-ice xG differential with teammate/opponent and context controls.
inputs: on-ice skaters from shift stint at event time
strength, score diff, period seconds, zone, rest days
opus.method: One design row PER SHOT (no rows for shot-free time). Response = shot xG (response_xg_differential = xg, always >=0). Context: is_home +/-1, period_seconds/1200, owner score diff, rest-day diff, one-hot strength_state, strength_exact, score bucket, zone_code, shot_zone_code. SE approx = sqrt(MSE / player rows).

codex.name: Per-source count, fantasy-point and goalie-event scoring (scoreLedger)
codex.purpose: Summarize each source on its own settled observed sample. For finite forecast/actual pairs compute MAE=mean(abs(forecast-actual)), signed bias=mean(forecast-actual), RMSE=sqrt(mean((forecast-actual)^2)), expected and actual sums, actual/expected total ratio, and Mincer–Zarnowitz regression actual=intercept+slope*forecast. Slope is covariance sum/forecast centered-squares sum; intercept=actual mean-slope*forecast mean. Separately compute goalie start/win/shutout Brier scores and ten probability-bin means. Report independent-universe coverage, phantoms, expected-FP decile and back-to-back slices.
codex.inputs_units: Settled source/player-game ledger predictions and actuals: skater G/A/PPP/SOG/HIT/BLK counts, goalie SV/GA/SA counts, fantasy points, goalie start/win/shutout probabilities [0,1] and known binary outcomes. Optional fantasy weights are points per category event; optional independent player-game universe contains known/unknown dressed membership. Rest days are calendar-day gaps.
codex.outputs_scale: Per source and player class: n/covered/dressed/phantoms and cohort sizes are counts. MAE, bias, RMSE and MZ intercept have head count or fantasy-point units; expected/actual are cohort totals. MZ slope and actual/expected ratio are dimensionless and not bounded. Probability scores and reliability predicted/observed fractions are [0,1]. Coverage is covered/dressed when known nonzero denominator, otherwise null. Deciles are labels 1..10 and probability bins 0..9. Floating summaries rounded to 4 decimals.

opus.name: FORGE v2 refresh cadence and material-event coalescing
opus.sub_family: FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (scheduling)
opus.purpose: Plan when FORGE v2 player-game forecasts are reissued (daily, pregame, material events), capped at game lock, and track horizon episodes.
source_tables: FORGE v2 refresh queue state and schedule observations (isolated persistence)
opus.method: lock = min(scheduled start, accepted lock). Daily job: deadline = min(08:00 America/New_York, found DST-safely as 12:00 or 13:00 UTC, lock), ready = min(now, deadline). Pregame: ready = deadline = min(start − 30 min, lock). Material event: ready = min(received + 5 min, deadline, lock − 1 ms), deadline = min(received + 15 min, lock). Pending unissued material jobs for the same target are coalesced, taking the minimum of lock/deadline/ready (≤1000 events). Scopes are capped at 100,000. Claim slots = min(batchSize, concurrency − running). A horizon episode number increments when a player-game re-enters the same horizon; episodes close when the horizon changes.

opus.name: FORGE projection accuracy metrics (MAE/RMSE/accuracy, Brier, interval coverage, holdout baselines)
opus.purpose: Score settled FORGE skater and goalie projections against actuals and persist daily accuracy, calibration and launch-gate diagnostics.
inputs: forge_player_projections / forge_goalie_projections predictions and uncertainty p10/p90
opus.method: Fantasy points via lib/projections/accuracy/fantasyPoints (computeSkaterFantasyPoints/computeGoalieFantasyPoints/computeAccuracyScore). MAE = mean|pred-act|, RMSE = sqrt(mean sq). opus.method: lead = UTC-day difference (game - now). Detailed excluded if lead >= horizon. If both valid and compatible (same unit/basis/integration): w = clamp((horizonDays - lead)/7, 0, 1); mean = w*detailed + (1-w)*baseline (so detailed only for lead <= horizon-7, linear fade over last 7 days). unconditionalMean = conditionalMean * participationProbability (1 if participationIntegrated). Falls back to baseline when detailed lacks participation. Exclusion reasons: stale, future_input, identity_conflict, outside_horizon, use_not_approved, etc.

opus.name: Plan evaluation totals (scheduled, active, bench games, projected value)
opus.purpose: Aggregate a whole plan over the date range into games and projected fantasy totals.
inputs: timeline roster at each game time
opus.method: Plays: roster members at puck drop (member.since < game time; no IR/IR+/NA; provider-listed out excluded). scheduledGames = plays; activeGames = planned rows excluding started/held locks; benchGames = max(0, scheduled - active). projectedStats = realized + sum of chosen forecast stats; projectedValue (points) = sum weight x projectedStats if all finite and no unresolved/conflict/stale schedule; else null. assignmentValue = sum playValue.

opus.output_scale: counts; projectedValue in fantasy points (realized + remaining)

opus.name: Candidate plan metrics (Best Fit swaps)
opus.purpose: Per available candidate, evaluate bounded one-acquisition plans and report net active games, net points, net goalie starts.
opus.method: Baseline = outcome (points, quality-selected) else agp. Candidates eligible sorted by horizon points desc then team game count; goalie boost reserves ceil(max/4) slots for goalies when minimum at risk (credited + expectedStarts < required). Round-robin proposals; netAGP = active - baseline.active; netPoints = projectedValue diff (only if comparable); netGoalieStarts = expectedStarts diff; dominated plans (netAGP and netPoints both <=) pruned; lost AGP/points of dropped players from contribution ledgers; up to 3 drop variants per sort.
opus.input_units: activeGames counts; fantasy points; expected starts
opus.output_scale: netAGP integer; netPoints fantasy points; netGoalieStarts real

opus.name: FORGE bridge skater line reuse and opponent/rest/tilt retargeting
opus.purpose: Turn each skater's latest FORGE one-game projection into per-game forecasts for every remaining game in the window.
opus.method: Exact-game row used as issued; otherwise latest line re-aimed: team = (1+goalsFor_new)/(1+goalsFor_old) from computeTeamStrengthContextAdjustment; rest = ratio of FORGE rest/home multipliers (toi, shot, goal, assist); tilt = ratio of opponent F/D tilts. Goals x team x goal x toi x tilt.points; assists x team x assist x toi x tilt.points; shots x team x shot x toi x tilt.shots; TOI/hits/blocks x toi; POINTS/PP_POINTS/SH_POINTS re-summed; round 4 dp. Skaters missing from team's latest run get no line (stale). Conditioning 'unconditional', startProbability null; expires min(puck drop, issuedAt + 8 days). Runs: lookback 7, ahead 7 days, proof of excluded third-party inputs required.
consumers: loadPlanningData -> RSO planner, streaming, candidate metrics
opus.input_units: FORGE heads per game (goals/assists/shots counts; TOI seconds -> minutes); team xG fractional adjustments; rest days
opus.output_scale: per-game expected stat line (counts, TOI minutes), rounded 4 dp

opus.name: Bridge goalie per-start line, wins and expected stats
opus.purpose: Per-start goalie line re-aimed to the opponent, win credit, and expected (x start chance) stats.
inputs: forge_goalie_projections (saves, GA, SA, shutout prob, win prob)
opus.method: Per start: SAVES, GA, SA, SHUTOUTS=shutout prob, GOALIE_MINUTES 60, GAMES_STARTED 1. Retarget: shots factor = (1+SA_to)/(1+SA_from) x (1+venue_to)/(1+venue_from); GA factor similarly; shutout = min(1, p/GAfactor). Venue/rest context = clamp(oppRest(+0.03 rested / -0.04 B2B) + ownB2B 0.02 + (home -0.01 / away +0.02), -0.15, 0.2). Team win: own/(own+other) if both FORGE values, own/0.984, 1-other/0.984, else FORGE Poisson model on xG priors x rest goal multipliers. WINS = win x 0.984; LOSSES = 1 - WINS. Expected stats = round4(line x startProbability).
opus.input_units: per-start saves/GA/SA counts, shutout prob 0-1, team win prob 0-1, venue/rest fractional adjustments
opus.output_scale: expected per-game goalie stats (counts x start prob); wins/losses expected per game 0-1

opus.name: DUST daily lineup assignment (min-cost max-flow)
opus.purpose: Assign a day's scheduled roster players to active slot instances, maximising starts then player value.
opus.method: Bipartite graph source->player(cap1,cost0)->eligible slot(cap1,cost -value)->sink. Successive shortest augmenting paths with Bellman-Ford (EPSILON 1e-10) until no path: maximum cardinality first, then minimum cost (max total value) among max-cardinality matchings. Non-finite value -> 0 with warning. Players/slots sorted by id for deterministic ties; benched = valid players unmatched; invalid-eligibility players are 'unresolved' and excluded.
opus.input_units: player.value (external canonical value, unitless); one game per player-date
opus.output_scale: integer counts of started/benched player-games per day

Depth loop maxSteps (default 4), beam width 8 (frontier = no-move + top 7), per-depth phase budget floor((maxEvals-3)/(maxSteps x 2)); proposals interleave candidates by date index; action time = zoned midnight (minus 1 day for next_day); each proposal yields add-only, reserve-prerequisite, top-2 drops, then remaining drops. opus.name: Streaming chain window DP (1 vs 2 spots)
opus.purpose: Build day-by-day add/drop chains that spend the period's adds for most added active games, then points.
opus.method: Daily leagues only. budget = floor(period.remaining / acquisitionCost), one acquisition period. Per drop: capacity gain per day = maxMatch(with player) - maxMatch(without). Windows [start,end): candidate plays on days with gain>0 (first day only if claim before puck drop); ranked list top 12. DP best[start][used] = max over end of leg(ranked[0]) + best[end][used+1] (last leg held to end); value compares min(need, starts), then (pointsFirst) points, then games, then points, then fewer adds (1e-9 tolerance). Subtract dropped player's lost games/points/starts from start. Singles: first 3 drops always, more while work <= 2,000,000 and before deadline. Pairs: top 4 single drops, all splits of budget, second spot on top of first. Two-spot recommended only if it beats one-spot.
outputs: alternatives (<=3 other first drops + other-goal best)
opus.input_units: per-day capacity counts; blended fantasy points; adds (acquisition allowance / cost)
opus.output_scale: chains with netGames integer, netPoints/netScore fantasy points

codex.name: Per-source count, fantasy-point and goalie-event scoring (scoreLedger)
codex.purpose: Summarize each source on its own settled observed sample. For finite forecast/actual pairs compute MAE=mean(abs(forecast-actual)), signed bias=mean(forecast-actual), RMSE=sqrt(mean((forecast-actual)^2)), expected and actual sums, actual/expected total ratio, and Mincer–Zarnowitz regression actual=intercept+slope*forecast. Slope is covariance sum/forecast centered-squares sum; intercept=actual mean-slope*forecast mean. Separately compute goalie start/win/shutout Brier scores and ten probability-bin means. Report independent-universe coverage, phantoms, expected-FP decile and back-to-back slices.
codex.inputs_units: Settled source/player-game ledger predictions and actuals: skater G/A/PPP/SOG/HIT/BLK counts, goalie SV/GA/SA counts, fantasy points, goalie start/win/shutout probabilities [0,1] and known binary outcomes. Optional fantasy weights are points per category event; optional independent player-game universe contains known/unknown dressed membership. Rest days are calendar-day gaps.
codex.outputs_scale: Per source and player class: n/covered/dressed/phantoms and cohort sizes are counts. MAE, bias, RMSE and MZ intercept have head count or fantasy-point units; expected/actual are cohort totals. MZ slope and actual/expected ratio are dimensionless and not bounded. Probability scores and reliability predicted/observed fractions are [0,1]. Coverage is covered/dressed when known nonzero denominator, otherwise null. Deciles are labels 1..10 and probability bins 0..9. Floating summaries rounded to 4 decimals.

opus.name: Swap category gain/sacrifice breakdown
opus.purpose: Explain a plan vs no-move lineup per category: delta, gains, sacrifices, ratio components.
opus.method: Per player summed stats in each plan; net per player = after - before. Counting categories: gain = sum max(0, net) x multiplier, sacrifice = sum max(0, -net) x multiplier; delta = plan own - baseline own. Ratio categories: net numerator and denominator components. Null when manifests differ, illegal, schedule stale, or goalie-category forfeiture risk.
opus.output_scale: category units: delta, gain, sacrifice; ratio component nets

opus.name: Results Luck Index (component-aware, written)
opus.purpose: Index (100 = normal) of whether a skater's current-window results run hot/cold vs a non-overlapping season-remainder baseline.
inputs: goals/ixG/shot_attempts totals for window and season
opus.method: Baseline = season total minus current-window total. Components: GAx (G-ixG) signed, scale 2, weight 0.35; SAX% (G/att - ixG/att, x100) signed, scale 10, weight 0.25; IPP% ratio, weight 0.20; on-ice GF-xGF signed, scale 4, weight 0.20. Signed component index = clamp(100 + (current-baseline)/scale*100, 0, 200); ratio index = clamp(current/baseline*100, 0, 200). Index = weighted mean of usable components. Publish only if all weights usable and baseline window excluded (or season + peer_fallback). Season window uses last20 as current and has no baseline. Interpretation bands: >=120 hot, 105-119 slightly hot, 95-105 normal, 80-94 slightly cold, <=79 cold.
opus.input_units: goal counts, xG goals, attempt counts, IPP percent 0-100
opus.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings when source coverage verified
opus.reference_standard: PDO / regression-to-mean of shooting % and on-ice Sh% (Tango-style true-talent regression)

opus.purpose: Season-to-date 0-100 impact ratings for skaters (offense, defense) and goalies from NST game logs.
inputs: nst_*_per_60 (points, goals, first assists, ixG, shots, iCF, oi xGF/xGA/CA/SCA, blocks, takeaways, giveaways, def zone starts)
goalie saves, SA, GA, TOI, nst_all/5v5 GSAA, gsaa_per_60, quality_starts_pct
opus.method: Per player, TOI-weighted mean of per-game per-60 rates over all game rows <= snapshot. Components z-scored across all players (population SD; missing -> z=0). Offense = 0.24 P/60 + 0.16 G/60 + 0.12 A1/60 + 0.16 ixG/60 + 0.10 SOG/60 + 0.08 iCF/60 + 0.08 oiXGF/60 + 0.06 (oiXGF%-50). Defense = 0.24 -oiXGA/60 + 0.14 -oiCA/60 + 0.12 -oiSCA/60 + 0.16 (oiXGF%-50) + 0.12 (oiCF%-50) + 0.10 blocks/60 + 0.08 (TK-GV)/60 + 0.04 DZS/60. Goalie = 0.50 GSAA/60 + 0.28 SV% + 0.12 QS% + 0.10 -GA/60. Raw x shrink factor TOI/(TOI+k), k=3600 s skaters, 2400 s goalies. rating_0_to_100 = ordinal percentile 100*(1 - index/(N-1)).

opus.purpose: Current-season player stats for a team against a chosen opponent, plus landing leaders.
inputs: per-game strength rows (toi_es/pp/pk seconds, goals/assists/shots by strength)
opus.method: Sum ES+PP+PK TOI and counts vs opponent; P/GP; Sh% = G/SOG; avg TOI = total/GP; PP TOI/G; PP% (share) = player PP TOI / team PP TOI vs that opponent; PP shot share = player PP shots / roster PP shots. Goalie SV% = saves/SA; GAA = GA*3600/TOI; QS if SV% > .910 or (SA <= 20 and SV% >= .885); QS% = QS/GS.
opus.status: live — /api/v1/splits
opus.reference_standard: Vollman Quality Start (SV% >= league avg, or >= .885 on <=20 shots)

opus.name: Gamma / Beta / Normal trend band (value, CI, z, percentile)
opus.purpose: Per player/metric/window: decayed EWMA, shrunk value, 80% band, pseudo-z and band percentile.
opus.method: Take first N samples. Gamma: decayed counts/minutes, ewma=60*Σwc/Σwe; value=blend(ewma,baseline,nEff=Σwe minutes,k=prior); prior shape0=baseline/60*k+1e-3, rate0=k+1e-3; CI = gamma 10/90% quantiles*60. Beta: ewma=Σws/Σwt; value=blend(n=Σwt); alpha0=baseline*k+0.5, beta0=(1-baseline)*k+0.5; CI beta 10/90%. Normal: ewma=Σwv/Σw; var=max(Σwv²/Σw-ewma²,1e-4); margin=1.28155*sd/max(sqrt(Σw),1); value=blend. z=(value-baseline)/((upper-lower)/(2*1.28155)); percentile=clamp(10+80*(value-lower)/(upper-lower),0,100).

entries.name: Beta-binomial empirical-Bayes window z (eb_z)
entries.purpose: Standardise a window rate against the player's (or league) Beta baseline using beta-binomial predictive variance.

opus.name: Beta-binomial empirical-Bayes window z (eb_z)
opus.purpose: Standardise a window rate against the player's (or league) Beta baseline using beta-binomial predictive variance.
inputs: alpha0,beta0 (player posterior if same position group, else league prior)
opus.method: strength=a+b; priorMean=a/strength; priorVar=ab/(strength^2(strength+1)); p_hat=s/n; shrink=strength/(strength+n); varMixed=priorMean(1-priorMean)(strength+n)/(n(strength+1)) [beta-binomial predictive variance of s/n]; z=(p_hat-priorMean)/max(sqrt(varMixed),sqrt(1e-9)). n=0 -> z=0. Non-finite outputs replaced by 0 before persist. Rounded z to 6dp.

entries.purpose: Exploratory test of whether BLSH references predict next-5-game production.

opus.name: BLSH forecast development comparison (arms P0-P3, gamma transfer, cluster bootstrap)
opus.purpose: Exploratory test of whether BLSH references predict next-5-game production.
opus.method: Origins: 5-game window + next 5 games in same season, gaps ≤30 days, no team change. P0 = mean of previous season's last 50 games; P1 = shrunk reference rate × window TOI/game; P1_H = rate × history TOI/game; P2_transfer = (rate + delta·beta/3600)·tau; P2 = rate shifted by gamma (no-intercept WLS of 3600·(next5 rate − reference rate) on ΔX, equal weight per player, ×0.5); P3 = window mean. FP/G+A floored 0. Composite weights a_t=(1/3)/sd_t/sqrt(w'Rw) from training targets. Paired MAE/RMSE differences with player cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, mulberry32 seed 20261029), 95% percentile CI. Decision: FP P2<P0 CI below 0, P2<P1 point, G+A and GS not worse.

opus.name: BLSH opportunity split (per-game vs PP/non-PP-rate-adjusted comparison)
opus.purpose: Tell whether a production gap is explained by ice-time / power-play role change.
inputs: history games (seconds, ppSeconds, tracks, goals, assists, ppPoints, weight)
opus.method: Weights normalised to Kish effective games n_eff; perGame mean and weighted SD. Split: PP point value = 3+goalShare for FP, 1 for G+A (GS not split); nonPpRate=(perGame*n_eff - value*PPP)/nonPP seconds; ppRate shrunk to cohort with pseudo-exposure k=3600 s ((value*PPP + k*cohortRate)/(pp+k)); personal-only if pp≥1800 s. (a) per-game: expected=n*perGame, scale=SD*sqrt(n); (b) adjusted: expected=r0*nonPP+r1*PP, scale=sqrt(n*residualSD^2 + PP^2*value*r1/ppExposure). z=gap/scale, |z|<0.5 balanced, z>0 sell_high, z<0 buy_low. Assessment matrix (agree/explains/withheld). Opportunity effect = (b)-(a) or ratePerSecond*ΔTOI. minGames 20.

opus.method: Donors: same position, exactly 50 prior games, single position, excluding target. Per donor rate=Σy/Σt; residual cov from ten 5-game blocks Σ e_i e_j / t_b / 9. mu=mean donor rate; observedCov (n-1); omega=mean residual cov; noise=mean(omega/seconds); base=observedCov+noise; signal = PSD projection (eigen-clip) of (observedCov-noise) in standardised units; metric = pseudo-inverse of base (correlation eigen, tol eps). Needs ≥2 donors.

opus.name: BLSH stage 4a: process-support sensitivity model (within-player beta, SHRINK 0.5)
opus.purpose: Fit how 5-game changes in process (ixG/60, on-ice xGF/60, xGA/60) move production, on disjoint training blocks.
inputs: training blocks: 5 ordered games, seconds, X=process per-60, Y=track per-hour rates, teams, positions
opus.method: Exclude target player, other positions, unqualified blocks, blocks with team/position change. Group by player-season (≥2 blocks). Exposure-weighted within-player-season deviations dx, dy; weights q/(players*seasonsPerPlayer). Cxx=Σ w dx dx', Cxy=Σ w dx dy'. beta = 0.5 × pinv(Cxx)·Cxy (eigen pseudo-inverse in correlation units). cohortX=weighted mean process; deltaMin/Max = observed deviation range.
opus.output_scale: beta: production per hour per unit process/60

opus.name: Probability floor, rounding, winner threshold, confidence label, market edge bucket
opus.purpose: Final post-processing of the home-win probability into labels used on the page and in metrics.
opus.method: floor = model.probabilityFloor ?? 0.05, bounded [0,0.49]; p clipped [floor, 1-floor]; round 6 dp. predicted winner = home if p >= 0.52 (BASELINE_WINNER_DECISION_THRESHOLD, clamp 0.01-0.99) also reports threshold-50 winner. confidence: |p-0.5| >= 0.15 high, >= 0.07 medium else low. modelVsMarketEdge = p - marketNoVig; bucket |edge| >= 0.08 large, >= 0.04 medium, >= 0.015 small, else efficient; null -> no_market.

opus.name: Promotion gate and segment regression guardrails
opus.purpose: Decides whether a candidate model can replace production.
inputs: current/candidate log loss, Brier, calibration gap, evaluated games
opus.method: promote only if: evaluatedGames >= 100; logLoss improvement >= 0.002; candidate calibration max gap <= 0.05 and regression <= 0.005; Brier not worse; simple baseline coverage >= 95% of candidate games and candidate beats strongest simple baseline on log loss and Brier; no market features unless pre-cutoff snapshots; no phase segment regression (>= 20 games, Brier +0.005 or log loss +0.01); public explanation ready. Calibration buckets on confidence max(p,1-p) edges 0.5/0.55/0.6/0.65/0.7/0.8/0.9; gap = |accuracy - avg confidence|. Ablation recommend keep/reject/review by sign of accuracy, Brier, log loss deltas.

opus.name: matview team_power_ratings_daily__new (sql/001)
opus.purpose: Daily team offense/defense/pace ratings via EWMA, shrinkage and z-scores, plus finishing/goalie/danger/special/discipline components
inputs: NST team per-60 rates and 5v5 counts
opus.method: params lookback 25 games, half-life 10 games, mode setting team_power_mode (all|5v5). pace = (CF60+CA60)/2. EWMA weight 0.5^(age/10) over last 25 games in season. Shrink: w = min(1, gp_to_date/10); metric = w*EWMA + (1-w)*league daily avg. z = (metric - daily league mean)/daily league stddev_samp. off_raw = 0.7 z_xGF + 0.2 z_SF + 0.1 z_GF; def_raw = 0.7(-z_xGA) + 0.2(-z_SA) + 0.1(-z_GA); ratings = 100 + 15*z-standardized raw. PP/PK tiers via percentile_cont 0.33/0.67 per date. trend = AVG(off_rating) prior 10 rows. extras (single-game, per date): finishing = GF60-xGF60, goaltending = xGA60-GA60, danger = HDCF/(HDCF+HDCA), PP xGF60, PK xGA60, discipline diff, PDO; each z per date; component rating = 100+15*z; special = 100+15*(0.20 z_pp_off + 0.20(-z_pk_def)); variance_flag if |z_pdo|>=1.

opus.name: Heuristic approximate xG per shot
opus.purpose: Assign an expected-goal value to each unblocked/blocked attempt for team and fallback individual xG.
opus.method: Hand-set lookup, not a trained model. Per shot: base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low danger; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road crossing; if goal, value=max(value,0.25); cap 0.95; null if distance/angle missing. INCLUDES: x,y normalized to the attacking direction by mirroring (x,y)->(-x,-y) when the shooting team attacks the left side, from home_team_defending_side (web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51); net fixed at (89,0); distance = Euclidean feet to (89,0) (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182); angle = atan2(|dy|,|dx|) degrees (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192), used only through the danger buckets (<=20 ft & <=35 deg high; <=40 ft & <=50 deg medium; else low); rebound flag (DEFAULT_REBOUND_WINDOW_SECONDS=3, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:6); rush flag (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS=10, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5); royal-road crossing (prior and current event y of opposite sign, both x>=25, nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277); goal outcome (as a floor). EXCLUDES: shot type, distance/angle as continuous terms (bucketed only), strength state, score state/score effects, shooter talent, goalie effects, venue/rink scorer bias adjustment, time/period, empty-net handling, training set or seasons (none — constants are hand-set), model type (none; lookup table, not logistic/GBM), calibration to league goal rate (none). Blocked attempts are not excluded in team summaries (attempt type not checked before assigning xG). A copy of the same proxy is in nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:~410 (other slice).

opus.name: Player trend rolling averages, running mean and variance
opus.purpose: Per player per metric per game: raw value, cumulative mean, L3/L5/L10 rolling mean, sample variance and SD
inputs: per-game player rows sorted by player and date
opus.method: Accumulator per player+metric across ALL supplied history (no season reset; version 'full-history'). Null values skipped (not zero). average = sum/count; rolling_avg_k = simple mean of last k non-null values, null until k values; variance = (sumSq - sum^2/n)/(n-1), clamped >=0, null if n<2; SD = sqrt. Records emitted only from emitFromDate (7-day repair window).
outputs: player_trend_metrics.raw_value, average_value, rolling_avg_3, rolling_avg_5, rolling_avg_10, variance_value, std_dev_value, sample_size
opus.input_units: per-game metric values in source units (see skater/goalie definitions); one row per player-date
opus.output_scale: same units as input; rolling L3/L5/L10 simple means of non-null values; sample variance/SD; sample_size count

opus.name: Skater trend percentile series with low-sample shrink

inputs: player_trend_metrics.raw_value, rolling_avg_3, rolling_avg_5, rolling_avg_10, game_date per metric
opus.method: Value per player game index gp: stored rolling avg (3/5/10) else trailing mean of last N raw values; window 20 always trailing mean; window 1 raw. At each gp, players are sorted and percentile = idx/(n-1)*100 (inverted if lower is better; single player = 50). If gp < MIN_TREND_SAMPLE_GAMES=10, percentile shrunk toward 50: 50 + (raw-50)*gp/10. Rank by latest percentile; delta = previous qualified rank - current rank; low-sample rows get delta 0.

opus.name: Legacy sKO characteristic-game classifier (z-scores, weighted chi-square thresholds, stat weights)
opus.sub_family: Rolling player averages & trends / legacy sKO
opus.purpose: Label each game as Highly/Moderately/Uncharacteristic versus the player's prior games.
inputs: shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct, time_on_ice, pa_to_sa_ratio, sog_per_60, pp_toi_pct_per_game
opus.method: Weights = normalized inverse of importance ratings (SH% 4.0625, IPP 4.8125, oiSH% 6.263, ZS% 6.583, TOI 4.692, PA/SA 6.571, SOG/60 4.0625, PPTOI% 4.667) -> sum to 1. For game i, baseline = mean and population SD (divide by n) over games 0..i-1; SD 0 -> 1. z capped at +/-5; per-stat label |z|<=1 Highly, <=2 Moderately, else Uncharacteristic. Score = sum w*z^2; T1 = sum w (=1), T2 = T1 + 2*sqrt(2*sum w^2) (chi-square-1 mean/variance approximation). PA/SA ratio: current game capped at 10 (SA=0 & PA>0 -> 10); prior games recomputed with Infinity for SA=0, then non-finite values filtered out of mean/SD. First game -> 'Insufficient History'.
opus.input_units: per-game values: shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct (percent units undeclared), time_on_ice (units undeclared, WGO usually seconds), sog_per_60 (per-60), pp_toi_pct_per_game, PA/SA ratio
opus.output_scale: z-scores capped +/-5; weighted sum of squared z (>=0); T1=1, T2=1+2*sqrt(2*sum w^2); categorical labels

opus.name: Per-60 weighted rate metrics
opus.purpose: Event rates per 60 minutes over each scope from summed raw events and summed TOI seconds.
source_tables: nst_gamelog_*_counts (shots, icf, goals, total_assists, first_assists, second_assists, penalties_drawn, total_penalties, hits, shots_blocked)
opus.method: Per game components = {num: raw events, den: TOI seconds}; if raw missing but a per-60 rate exists (sog/ixg only), num = rate * TOI / 3600. Scope value = sum(num)/sum(den) * 3600 (seconds -> per 60 min). No TOI -> component null (slot kept, nothing added). goals_per_60 at PP uses its own TOI chain counts.toi -> countsOi.toi -> rates.toi_per_gp -> PP TOI (builder PPTOI, else WGO pp_toi). Numerators: sog/hits/blocks/goals/penalties use NST counts with WGO all-strength fallback; assists_per_60, primary/secondary_assists_per_60, shot_attempts_per_60 use NST counts only.
opus.input_units: raw event counts per game; TOI in seconds (NST mm:ss parsed to seconds); NST rates shots_per_60/ixg_per_60 are per-60 rates
opus.output_scale: per-60 rate (events per 60 minutes) = sum(events)/sum(TOI s)*3600; ratio of sums

opus.name: Player trend page: rolling-vs-baseline delta %, hot/cold streak and L7/L14/L30 quick cards
opus.purpose: Client-side comparison of a player's rolling window value against a chosen baseline, streak labelling, and calendar-day recent averages on /trends/player/[playerId].
opus.method: absolute = rolling - baseline; delta% = (rolling - baseline)/|baseline|*100 (null when baseline 0). Streak: latest delta >= +8 -> hot, <= -8 -> cold, else steady; streak length = consecutive most-recent games with delta >= 0 (hot) or <= 0 (cold), a sign test rather than the 8% threshold; averageDelta = mean of all deltas; metrics sorted by |latestDelta|. opus.name: Ratio-of-sums rolling/historical aggregation engine
opus.purpose: Shared accumulator that computes every ratio and per-60 metric from summed numerator/denominator components over last-N, all-processed, season, 3-year and career scopes.
opus.method: Value = (sum num / sum den) * scale, optionally + (sum num2 / sum den2) * scale ('sum' combine, used by PDO), then * outputScale, rounded to 6 dp. Never averages per-game ratios. Windows 3/5/10/20 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_GAME_WINDOWS) are FIFO queues of the last N slots. For ratio_performance and weighted_rate_performance families the window mode is 'appearance': a slot is consumed only when anchor=true (all-strength: every WGO row; split strengths: TOI>0), and a slot with missing/invalid components still occupies the slot but adds nothing. A missing numerator beside a present denominator drops the components (explicit 0 still counts). No denominator -> null or 0 per spec. Historical buckets are keyed by season and are NOT anchor-gated; 3YA = seasons with startYear in [current-2, current]; career = every season bucket read.
opus.input_units: raw component totals (counts, TOI seconds, on-ice counts); season ids like 20242025
opus.output_scale: depends on spec: scale 3600 -> per-60 rate; scale 100 -> percent 0-100; scale 1 -> fraction 0-1; PDO sum*0.01 -> index ~1.0 (0-2). Ratio of sums, never mean of ratios; rounded 6 dp

entries.name: Approximate xG fallback heuristic
entries.purpose: Assign an xG value per shot attempt when no model xG is attached.

opus.name: Approximate xG fallback heuristic
opus.purpose: Assign an xG value per shot attempt when no model xG is attached.
opus.method: Base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road; if the shot is a goal, value = max(value, 0.25); cap 0.95. Applied to every shot attempt type including blocked and missed. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
outputs: xG per attempt -> ixg, xgf, xga, goalie xg_against, gsaa
consumers: ixG, xGF, xGA, xGF%, goalie xG against / 'gsaa' in buildNstParityMetrics
opus.output_scale: xG per attempt, probability-like 0.02-0.95 (summed to xGF/xGA in goals)

opus.name: NST radar season values (on-ice shares, per-60 rates, league sample minima)
opus.purpose: Compute a skater's season value and the league comparison values for the /stats/player radar from NST all-strength season views.
inputs: cf, ca, ff, fa, sf, sa, gf, ga, xgf, xga, hdca, toi_seconds_oi
goals_per_60, total_assists_per_60, total_points_per_60, shots_per_60, ixg_per_60, icf_per_60, ihdcf_per_60, hits_per_60, pim_per_60, toi_seconds
opus.method: On-ice shares = for/(for+against)*100 (0-100 scale) for CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF% (ratio of season sums from NST counts). Per-60 rates are taken as stored NST values (not recomputed) except hdca_per_60 = hdca*3600/toi_seconds_oi. League rows must clear minima: CF+CA>=20, FF+FA>=15, SF+SA>=10, GF+GA>=1, xGF+xGA>=1, toi_seconds>=3600 (1 h) for rates, toi_seconds_oi>=3600 for HDCA/60; player row is NOT filtered. Consumer percentile = round(#league values strictly worse / N * 100); rank = #strictly better + 1; inverted for 'isInverted' stats and GAA.

opus.name: Contextual shot features (shift age, PP age, movement, royal road)
opus.purpose: Per-shot shooter/team shift ages, previous shift gaps/durations, power-play age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing.
opus.method: Shift age = event period second - active shift start; previous gap/duration from player's prior shift; owner/opponent averages and max over on-ice players. PP age = seconds since the team's current PP segment started (restarts if strength_exact changes). Movement (same-team prior event only): east-west = |dy|, north-south = dx. Royal road crossed if both x>=25 and y sign flips (non-zero). XG ROLE: INCLUDES shooter shift age, owner PP age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing (x>=25 ft both events, y sign flip) as model features; EXCLUDES opponent PP age, owner/opponent average shift age and previous-shift gaps from first_pass_v1 (computed but unused there), pre-shot passes (not in NHL PbP).

opus.name: Coordinate normalization, shot distance and angle
opus.purpose: Mirror raw rink coordinates to the attacking direction and compute distance/angle to the net at (89,0).
opus.method: Attacking side: home attacks opposite its defending side, away attacks the home defending side. If attacking 'left', negate x and y. XG ROLE: x,y mirrored only when the owner attacks 'left' (both x and y negated); net fixed at (89,0); no rink-bias/scorekeeper adjustment (excluded); distance and angle are both trained-model features and fallback-bucket inputs.

opus.name: Goalie parity counts, SV%, GAA and 'GSAA'
opus.purpose: Compute goalie shots against, saves, GA, SV%, GAA, xGA, GSAA, HD/MD/LD SV% and GAA, rush/rebound attempts against, average shot/goal distance.
opus.method: Goalie team = team opposite event owner. SA/saves from goal+SOG excluding own goals; GA counts all goals incl. own goals. SV% = saves/SA*100. GAA = GA*3600/TOI. xg_against = sum of approximate xG for all non-own-goal attempts. gsaa = xg_against - GA. HD SV% = hd_saves/hd_SA*100; hd_gaa = (hd_SA - hd_saves)*3600/TOI; md/ld analogous; hd/md/ld_gsaa hard-coded null. avg distances = mean shot/goal distance in feet. Per-60 versions via toPer60 including gsaa_per_60. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
consumers: underlying stats goalie views via playerStatsLandingServer.ts
opus.input_units: shot counts; TOI seconds; distance feet; xG in goals
opus.output_scale: SV% percent 0-100; GAA per 60 (per 3600 s); gsaa in goals (xGA-GA); avg distance feet

opus.name: NST rate-limit admission window math (local ledger + shared RPC + Python admission)
opus.purpose: Decide when the next NST request may start so the rolling 1m/5m/15m/1h windows and 21 s spacing are never exceeded across callers.
where: web/lib/nst/requestBudget.ts:107 (1h ledger prune + window wait loop to :120)
web/lib/nst/client.ts:281 (admission deadline = run deadline - timeout - 5 s)
inputs: request URL (key param stripped, sorted, sha256)
opus.method: Windows: 1m max 39, 5m max 80, 15m max 100, 1h max 180; min spacing 21,000 ms. Local ledger: drop inactive attempts older than 1 h; wait = max(100 ms if same URL in flight, last.startedAt + max(last.intervalMs, intervalMs) - now, for each window with count>=max: the (count-max)-th oldest startedAt + windowMs + 1 - now). Interval = 0 only when minIntervalMs==0 AND plannedRequestCount is a safe integer 1..78 (semi-burst, 'two 39-attempt waves'); else max(21000, minIntervalMs). Every network attempt (incl. retries) counts. Shared RPC: POST with p_burst/p_planned_requests; if allowed, permit must be used within permitTtlMs=1000 ms measured from before the POST; if denied sleep max(25 ms, waitMs). Python mirror: same receipt checks, burst iff min_interval_ms==0 and 1<=planned_requests<=78, default min_interval_ms 21000, default deadline now+220 s, sleep max(0.025 s, waitMs/1000). Static plan check: projected requests in a window at fixed cadence = min(n, floor(window/interval)+1).

consumers: functions/api/fetch_team_table.py and other Python NST callers
opus.input_units: milliseconds (TS: windowMs, intervalMs, waitMs, Date.now epoch ms); seconds (Python: time.monotonic, waitMs/1000); request counts per rolling window

opus.purpose: Build season top-5 skater (points, goals, PPP, BSH, by position) and goalie (wins, SV%, GAA, QS%) leaderboards for /stats.
inputs: points, goals, pp_points, blocked_shots, shots, hits
opus.method: BSH = blocked_shots + shots + hits. Skater boards: sort desc, top 5 (positions L->LW, R->RW). Goalie min GP = floor(0.25 * average team GP from latest standings) only when average team GP > 10, else 0. goalieRatio keeps finite values >=0 and <=max (max 1 for save_pct and QS%), else null. SV% and QS% sorted desc, GAA asc, top 5, require games_played > 0.
opus.input_units: season totals (points, goals, pp_points, blocked_shots, shots, hits); goalie save_pct and quality_starts_pct as FRACTION 0-1, goals_against_avg per 60, games_played; team games_played
opus.output_scale: top-5 ranked lists; BSH integer total; min GP integer threshold
opus.status: live — fetchStatsData used by web/pages/stats/index.tsx
opus.reference_standard: NHL.com goalie leader qualification (minimum games/minutes)

leads.text: observation, not audited: before average team GP exceeds 10 there is no goalie minimum, so a 1-GP goalie can lead SV%/GAA
observation, not audited: save_pct must be a 0-1 fraction; a 0-100 source value is silently nulled
observation, not audited: goalie games_played includes relief appearances; qualification is by GP, not minutes/shots as NHL uses

opus.name: WiGO player ratings (offense/defense/overall by strength)
opus.purpose: Weighted composite of stat percentiles per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) into 0-100 offense, defense and overall ratings.
inputs: per-60 rates and on-ice % per strength
opus.method: Per stat percentile (x100) vs cohort with gp >= cohortMinGp; withheld if < 20 peers (WIGO_RATING_MIN_COHORT_PEERS). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of peers with GP>=10)/10, clamped 0-100. Offense weights AS/ES: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PEND/60 5; defense AS/ES: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, BLK/60 10, TK/60 10, minor pen/60 5, GV/60 10 (lower better where noted); PP offense: GF/60 25, xGF/60 20, P/60 15, SCF/60 10, SOG/60 15, HDGF/60 10, PEND/60 5; PK defense: GA/60 25, xGA/60 20, SCA/60 15, SA/60 10, HDCA/60 10, BLK/60 10, TK/60 5. Rating = weighted mean of available percentiles. overall.as/es = mean(off,def); overall.st = PP-off and PK-def weighted by PP/PK TOI; final = mean(as, es, st).
opus.input_units: per-60 rates; percent fields as stored by NST import

Per-60 = count/(TOI_min/60); PP per-60 uses PP seconds. Recent L5/L10/L20: totals over last N games, ATOI = sum seconds/60/gp, pp_pct = unweighted mean of per-game pp_toi_pct, per-60 from seconds; metrics nulled when any game lacks TOI or the source field.

opus.name: FORGE starter probability model (computeStarterProbabilities)
opus.sub_family: Goalie starters & starter odds / starter odds
opus.purpose: Score each candidate goalie and convert to start probabilities (sigmoid for 2, softmax for 3).
inputs: L10 starts by goalie (forge_goalie_game, starter = max TOI per date)
opus.method: score = 2.4*(L10share-0.5) + 0.7*logit(prior clamp .01-.99) + 0.45*logit(lineCombo prior clamp .05-.95) + 0.5*clamp(GSAA60,+-0.6) + 0.28*(seasonStart%-0.5)*GP/(GP+10) + 0.2*GP/(GP+10); B2B: starter of previous game -2.75, other goalie +0.65; B2B & team weaker (GF + 0.35 < opp GF): primary (L10share>=0.6) -1.1, backup +0.45; weak opponent (GF <= 2.6): primary -0.7, backup +0.3; rust: >75 d -6, >30 d -3, >14 d -0.8, <=7 d +0.2. Two candidates: p = clamp(sigmoid(diff), .02, .98); three: softmax clamped .01-.98 (not renormalized). One candidate -> 1.
consumers: FORGE goalie stage -> starter board / start chart (serving flag)

opus.name: LeagueStandings team value, DraftSummaryModal steals/reaches/draft winner, DraftBoard heat
opus.purpose: Post-draft team scoring summaries and visual intensity.
opus.method: Standings value: points -> team projected FP; categories -> MEAN of player category z-sum values (roundRankHistory uses same mean for categories, sum for points). Steal/reach delta = pickNumber - ADP (max = steal, min = reach), keepers excluded. Draft winner = argmax 0.6*minmax(projectedPoints) + 0.4*minmax(teamVorp) (0.5 when all equal). Heat level = FP/maxFP in pool: <=0.2 ->1, <=0.4 ->2, <=0.7 ->3, else 4. Round rank = 1 + count of teams with value > team value + 1e-9; null if any player value missing.

opus.method: diff% = (actual-projected)/projected*100; projected 0 -> 0 if actual 0 else +/-99999 sentinel. opus.name: Community draft rankings: regularized Bradley-Terry with ADP prior
opus.purpose: Aggregate users' pairwise preferences into a public community top-250.
inputs: pair preferences (latest per user+pair, consent/moderation filtered)
candidates with marketRank = prior-season Yahoo preseason_average_pick (fallback average_draft_pick, min across mapped keys)
opus.method: Scores s_i, prior mean m_i = ln((F+1-r)/r) for market rank r (F = field size), 0 if unranked. Market prior weight = 4*max(0, 1-independentUsers/20). Objective: Bradley-Terry log-likelihood with P(i beats j)=sigmoid(s_i-s_j) - 0.25/2*s^2 (L2) - w_i/2*(s_i-m_i)^2. Diagonal (Jacobi) Newton: delta = clamp(0.5*grad/curvature, +/-1), up to 500 iters, tol 1e-8; must converge. Evidence states: emerging (>=5 users, >=10 comparisons, >=5 opponents), established (>=20 users, >=40 comparisons, >=10 opponents, >=2 opponents ranked 200-250 and >=2 ranked 251-300). stabilityBuffer = ceil(30/sqrt(users)+40/sqrt(comparisons)+10/sqrt(opponents)) (75 with no comparisons); conservativeRank = modelRank + buffer. Public top-250: market rank <=250 and not established (market prior), OR established and conservativeRank <= 250; renumbered 1..250 by model rank. rank_delta = previousPublicRank - publicRank.
opus.output_scale: latent score (log-odds scale); ranks 1..N; public rank 1..250
opus.status: live — community snapshot job (draft-ranker community route)
opus.reference_standard: Bradley-Terry / Elo-style paired comparison models with Gaussian prior (e.g. Glicko/TrueSkill shrinkage); Hunter MM algorithm

opus.name: Draft Ranker discovery signals: projection consensus gap, ownership risers, opportunity change
opus.purpose: Surface players whose projections, ownership or role outpace market ADP.
opus.method: Consensus rank = MEDIAN of per-source projection ranks (>=2 sources; conflicting duplicates drop the source). projection_gap if priorADP - consensus >= 25 (score = gap). previously_undrafted if consensus <= 300 (score = 301 - consensus). Ownership riser: latest vs point ~7 days earlier (gap 6-10 days, latest <=2 days old in season / 7 offseason); qualifies if delta >= 5 pp or >= top-decile (ceil(0.9n)-th) of positive deltas. Opportunity: verified event types with confidence >= 0.75 and unexpired, or team change; deployment share gain >= 0.15; score = max(rankGain, shareGain*100). Owner-relative: personalRank - consensusRank >= 25 -> cutoff_challenger if personal rank 251-275 else projection_gap.

opus.output_scale: score in ranks or percentage points

opus.name: Draft Ranker assisted placement: binary-search rank interval engine
opus.purpose: Place a new player in a personal ranking with pairwise questions.
opus.method: Initial interval by bucket (top_50 [1,50], 51-100, ..., outside_250 [251,N+1], unsure [1,N+1]). Ask the anchor nearest the interval midpoint; target_over_anchor -> high=min(high, rank); anchor_over_target -> low=max(low, rank+1); too_close -> [rank, rank+1]. When width<=1, validate ranks suggested-1, suggested and 250/251 cutoff; contradiction -> one retry then finish broadened. suggestedRank = floor((low+high)/2); plausible width +/-4 (<=100), 7 (<=200), 10 otherwise when broadened; confidence developing if contradictions, strong if >=5 questions else moderate. Cap 12 questions (16 with contradictions).

opus.method: Counting categories: sum. Otherwise 'estimated' workload-weighted mean of the rate (SV% by SA; GAA by starts then appearances; S% by SOG; FO% by attempts; TOI by GP); any invalid input -> unavailable. Ranks: competition ranking (ties share rank) ascending/descending by higherIsBetter (points league negative weights invert). Band: percentile=(N-rank+1)/N*100: <=25 red, <=50 orange, <=75 yellow, else green.

entries.name: buildPositionTiers / advisePosition: 1-D k-means positional tiers + take-now advice
entries.purpose: Automatic value tiers per position and Take now / Can wait advice.

opus.name: buildPositionTiers / advisePosition: 1-D k-means positional tiers + take-now advice
opus.purpose: Automatic value tiers per position and Take now / Can wait advice.
source_tables: projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source)
opus.method: Values min-max scaled to 0..1; exact contiguous 1-D k-means (DP on prefix sums), k=2..min(8,unique,n-1), best k by mean silhouette (neighbour-group 1-D silhouette); n<4 -> one band. Then recursively split any band wider than 0.05 of the scaled range at its min-SSE boundary. Tied values never split. breakThreshold = max(3*median adjacent gap, 0.25*IQR). Remaining band gap = last remaining in band minus first remaining in next non-empty band; meaningfulBreak if gap > breakThreshold. Advice: expected = sum availability over remaining band players; 'Can wait' if opposingPicks=0 or expected>=1.5 (and gap known); 'Take now' if expected<0.5 and meaningfulBreak. Tier adapter nulls values whose required inputs (SV% needs SA>0, GAA needs starts) are incomplete.
opus.input_units: fantasy points or z-score sum; ADP pick numbers
opus.status: live — Draft Pro tiers tab (gated) and mock draft pro bots
opus.reference_standard: Jenks natural breaks / 1-D k-means tiering (e.g. Boris Chen Gaussian-mixture tiers)

entries.purpose: Simulate opponent picks in mock drafts with personalities.

opus.name: Mock draft bot pick model (decide): utility score + softmax sampling
opus.purpose: Simulate opponent picks in mock drafts with personalities.
inputs: session players {value, adp, positions, categories, workload}
opus.method: range = max(1, top value - value at rank teamCount*3). score = (v - top)/range + 0.15*(v - baseline_pos)/range [baseline = value at index roster_pos*teamCount-1 in full pool] - max(0, ADP - pick)/(teamCount*(Vanilla?1:4)) + (needed ? (Conservative 0.65 : 0.28) : -0.25) - 0.25*max(0, heldAtPos - slots). Pro: + scarcity*0.22*min(2, planningWait/teamCount) where scarcity = max(0, v - replacement_value)/range and replacement = available player at index round(demand) (demand = sum over opponents picking before my next turn of 1 if they still need the position else 0.25); + min(0.3, gap/range) if needed and a meaningful tier break is nearly exhausted; categories weakness bonus clamp(+/-0.2, 0.04*sum cat_k/(1+held_k)). Free: + min(0.15, 0.08*scarcity). Personalities: Zero-G -1.5*max(0,0.9-progress) for G; Fade -0.65*(1-progress) at position; Reach +0.5+0.3*scarcity; Hero-G +min(0.9, workload/70)*(games?0.6:1); BPA +0.4*(v-top)/range; Contrarian + (0.4*positive - 0.6 fade|0.3 bust)*confidence(1/0.7/0.4). Shortlist (6, Aggressive pro 10) from plausible (rank<2T or ADP<=pick+2T or needed&scarcity>0.2) that keep rosters completable (max-flow feasibility). Turn planning (pro, consecutive picks): +0.3*max(next best + 0.35 if fits open slot). Choice ~ softmax(score/temperature), temperature 0.08 (Vanilla/BPA) else 0.13 (+0.22 Aggressive) + 0.04*variation; seeded FNV/mulberry RNG.

opus.name: useVORPCalculations: VORP / VOLS / VONA / VBD per player
opus.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
opus.purpose: Compute league-wide draft value over replacement (VORP), over last starter (VOLS), over next available (VONA) and the blended VBD rank value for every projected player.
source_tables: projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source)
opus.method: (1) REPLACEMENT LEVEL: per roster position p (C/LW/RW/D/G, or FWD/D/G when grouped; +FWD pool when rosterConfig.FWD>0) with T=teamCount and starters s_p (minus my filled slots when personalizeReplacement): VORP index = floor(T*(s_p + utilAdj_p) + 1) - 1 = T*(s_p+utilAdj_p) (0-based, i.e. the first player beyond league starters); VOLS index = floor(T*s_p) - 1 (the last league starter). UTIL slots are split 1/3 each to C/LW/RW (UTIL_TO_DEF_ENABLED=false so D gets 0); in 'fwd' grouping UTIL goes wholly to FWD. Bench slots are NOT counted (not handled). Goalies get no UTIL share. Replacement pool = remaining (available) players by default or full pool when baselineMode='full'; index clamped to pool length-1; empty pool -> replacement 0. (2) VALUE SOURCE: buildPlayerValues -> points leagues: projected fantasy points (source-weighted projection x league scoring; optional 84-game proration for skaters); categories leagues: sum of weighted z-scores from calculateCategoryScores. Optional Draft Pro position weight multiplier (0..2) applied to the value before pools. (3) VONA: N = floor(picksUntilNext); take the N available players with lowest Yahoo ADP (players without ADP ignored); each contributes 1/k to each of its k eligible positions -> expectedTaken_p. Baseline = value at index floor(currentIndexOfPlayerInAvailablePool_p + expectedTaken_p) in that position's available pool (or index floor(expectedTaken_p) if the player is not in the pool); VONA = value - baseline. Assumes opponents draft strictly by ADP; ignores opponent roster needs. (4) VBD = 0.6*VORP + 0.3*VONA + 0.1*VOLS (dashboard-specific blend; classic VBD uses one baseline). (5) MULTI-POSITION: eligibility normalized (F/FWD -> C,LW,RW); a player appears in every eligible pool; reported metrics come from the eligible position with max VORP (ties broken by VONA then VOLS) - not summed. Positional scarcity enters only through per-position replacement depth.
consumers: ProjectionsTable, SuggestedPicks, MyRoster, DraftBoard, LeagueStandings, DraftSummaryModal
opus.input_units: value: fantasy points (season totals; 84-game pace if prorate84) or dimensionless z-score sum; picksUntilNext in picks; ADP in overall pick number
opus.output_scale: VORP/VOLS/VONA/VBD in same units as value (fantasy points or z-score sum), unbounded, can be negative

opus.name: buildPersonalizedRecommendations (Draft Pro): need-weighted recommendation score
opus.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
opus.purpose: Personalize suggestion order by roster and category needs without changing league VORP.
inputs: candidates {globalVorp, rankValue, baselineScore, categoryValues, adp, eligiblePositions}
opus.method: (1) Replacement: not recomputed (uses candidate.rankValue/baselineScore). (2) Value source: rankScore = baselineScore ?? rankValue. Category values recomputed: SV% = saves/(saves+GA or SA), GAA = GA*3600/TOTAL_TOI (TOI in seconds); per-category z-scores via calculateCategoryScores over the CANDIDATE pool. (3) No VONA logic here; availability = estimatePlayerAvailability (reason tag only, not in score). (4) Position fit = max(clamp01(need_p)) over eligible positions. Category fit = sum(z_k * need_k)/sum(|need_k|*|w_k|) over enabled role-applicable categories; categories add position fit. normalizedFit = clamp01(fit / max(1, max|fit|)). recommendationScore = rankScore + alpha * normalizedFit * adjustmentScale, adjustmentScale = max(1, max |rankScore| over all candidates). (5) Multi-position: best eligible position need.
outputs: RecommendationResult {rankScore, recommendationScore, globalVorp, availabilityEstimate, reasons, missingCategories}
opus.input_units: rank values in FP or z units; needs 0..1 (position) or raw counts (categories); TOI seconds
opus.status: live — Draft Pro gated (draftProEligible); free path uses alpha only when needWeightEnabled
opus.reference_standard: Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative; SGP-based category need weighting

opus.name: estimatePlayerAvailability: ADP normal-survival availability probability

entries.name: calculateCategoryScores: weighted category z-score composite with goalie rate shrinkage
entries.purpose: Convert projected category stats to one comparable value for categories leagues.

opus.name: calculateCategoryScores: weighted category z-score composite with goalie rate shrinkage
opus.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
opus.purpose: Convert projected category stats to one comparable value for categories leagues.
inputs: categoryWeights (keys define enabled categories; default G,A,PPP,SOG,HIT,BLK)
opus.method: Per role (skater/goalie) and category: mean and SAMPLE std dev (n-1) over every player in the supplied pool with a finite value. Goalie SV% shrunk: (SA*sv + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200) (PRIOR_SHOTS=1200); GAA shrunk: (GS*gaa + 25*mean)/(GS+25) (PRIOR_STARTS=25). z = (value-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE, LOSSES_GOALIE. Score = sum weight_k * z_k (weight defaults to 1 if non-finite). GAMES_PLAYED and TOTAL_TOI apply to both roles. Categories with sd=0 or missing values contribute 0.
opus.input_units: projected season totals; SV% fraction 0-1; GAA goals/60
opus.status: live — categories leagues in Draft Dashboard, Draft Pro recommendations, mock drafts
opus.reference_standard: Standard z-score category valuation (e.g. Razzball/FanGraphs z-score method); SGP (standings gain points) as alternative; Tango-style regression to mean for rate stats

codex.name: Role-specific weighted category z-score sum

opus.method: Quick reject if held + available < teamCount × slots. Flow network: source → player groups (key = seat + sorted positions, capacity = group count) → (seat, slot type) nodes (capacity = slot count) → sink. Held groups connect only to their own seat; free players (seat −1) connect to any seat. Dinic max-flow (BFS levels plus DFS augment). Held players must all route (flow = held count); then free players are added to the residual graph and total flow must equal teamCount × slots.

opus.name: Hot/cold streak rules
opus.purpose: Flag L5 hot/cold streaks on share cards.
inputs: L5 points, point games, TOI, PP TOI, pre-L5 baselines
opus.method: Pre-L5 baseline = (season total - L5 total)/(GP-5). Hot: >=4/5 point games, >=0.85 P/GP, TOI >= +15% vs pre-L5 (>=3 pre games), PP TOI >= +35% (pre >= 30 s); specialists also HIT>2, BLK>2, SOG>2.5, PPP>0.5 per game. Cold mirrors (<=1/5, <=0.25 P/GP, -15%, -35%). Goalies hot QS>=4/5 or SV%>=.930; cold QS<=1 or SV%<=.870. Needs 5 recent games.
opus.status: live
